svg.text: Computation-Centric Multi-Stage Omni Runtime - Built on SGLang - sgl-project/sglang-omni
Request lifecycle - entry routing - abort broadcast
Each stage scheduler tuned to its bottleneck
Colocate adjacent stages - LOCAL_OBJECT fast path
ZMQ endpoints - GPU placement - relay wiring
ZMQ control-plane IO + relay data-plane IO
No KV cache - optional local batching
ForwardBatch - hooks - model forward - output processing
CUDA Graph optimizations from SGLang backbone
Inbox/outbox abstraction - each stage isolated so one bottleneck cannot degrade others
HTTP API - Client - Coordinator - Stage - Scheduler - ModelRunner - model forward
Step 1: HTTP API receives request - Client builds OmniRequest - SSE streaming setup
Step 2: Coordinator routes to entry_stage via SubmitMessage (ZMQ control plane)
Step 3: Stage reads relay payload - enqueues IncomingMessage to scheduler.inbox
Step 4: Scheduler runs stage loop - ModelRunner forward - OutgoingMessage to outbox
Step 5: Stage relay.put + DataReadyMessage - next stage or Coordinator CompleteMessage
Streaming: thinker hidden states stream_to talker via CUDA IPC (same GPU) or relay blob
Abort: Coordinator PUB/SUB AbortMessage - relay.cleanup(request_id) on all stages
Multi-stage decoding split by computational character - not just modality
Control plane (ZMQ): Submit / DataReady / Complete / Stream / Abort
Small coordination messages - control-before-wait for credit backends
Data plane (Relay): StagePayload tensors via shm/nccl/nixl/mooncake
Zero-copy shared memory - pickle metadata + flat uint8 tensor buffer
Design axis: multi-stage decoding (heterogeneous compute profiles) not just multi-modality
Add new model: declare PipelineConfig topology - no inference system from scratch
sgl-project/sglang-omni - CUDA/ROCm/XPU/NPU - TP per stage - disaggregated or colocated deployment
Init path: load PipelineConfig - runtime prep - spawn stage processes - wire ZMQ + relay - Coordinator ready
Step path: route through stage graph - per-stage scheduler - relay xfer - stream/terminal collect - respond
Sources: sgl-project/sglang-omni - docs.sgl-project.github.io/sglang-omni - developer_reference pipeline + communication
